question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

Solomon's reputation as an accountant is __taintless__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"taintless"** means free from any faults or defects; pure and unblemished. (निर्दोष)

 
 
• **Example:** His** taintless** record as a public servant made him a trusted figure in the community.
 
 
 
• **"Faultless"** refers to something or someone without any faults or errors; perfect. (निर्दोष)
 
 
• **Example:** Her performance in the recital was** faultless**, earning her a standing ovation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word** 'taintless' is synonymous with 'faultless'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (faultless)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flawed** (त्रुटिपूर्ण): Containing faults or imperfections.

 
 
• **Example:** The flawed design of the bridge led to its eventual collapse.
 
 
 
• **Dubious** (संदिग्ध): Hesitating or doubting; not to be relied upon.
 
 
• **Example:** His dubious methods of business raised many questions about his integrity.
 
 
 
• **Inconsistent** (असंगत): Not staying the same throughout; lacking agreement.
 
 
• **Example:** The inconsistent results of the experiment made it difficult to draw any conclusions.
